statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and lightheadedness
These symptoms have persisted despite initial management for known sick sinus syndrome
A 48-hour ambulatory electrocardiographic monitoring study (CPT 93226) is indicated
The service is to further evaluate the correlation between symptomatic events and potential arrhythmic activity
The claim was denied based on Reason Code PR-204
The denial reason is that the service is not covered under the patient's current benefit plan
